limits.value: up to 40 requests per minute (RPM) for most models, per account; no per-token billing; the account's own limit is shown in the top-right of the dashboard

free_tier.stated: free tier with no per-token billing, rate limited to up to 40 requests per minute (RPM) for most models; each account's own limit is shown in the dashboard
free_tier.notes: the FAQ states only the per-minute figure, up to 40 requests per minute for most models; it states no per-day request figure

identity_cost.detail: an NVIDIA account (email) plus a one-time password sent to a phone number before an API key can be generated; the phone form refuses numbers located in AF, BD, BY, CU, IR, KZ, KG, KP, PK, RU, SY, TJ, TZ and UZ; no card required
